data.title: Kiara at Damac Hills
data.about:
Welcome to Kiara, the most luxurious golf course apartments nestled in Damac Hills. Choose from studios, 1, 2, 3 bedroom homes, each of them ready to move and fully furnished. The lifestyle offered is high-end paired with theb best of amenities you can ever dream of.

If you are a golf enthusiast, this is just the place for you. Come home to the Trump International Golf Club in Dubai. Choose Kiara if you want to live amidst nature and enjjoy the tranquil life in one of the most dynamic and exciting cities of the world, Dubai.

location_tile.title: Kiara is located within Damac Hills
location_tile.description:
This is nestled within Dubailand, close to all major landmarks of the city. When you live at Kiara, you will be close to Arabian Ranches, Dubai Motor City as well as Remraam. Choose Kiara if you want a home within nature but close to the city’s attractions!

  • 06 mins – Mudon
  • 11 mins – Dubai Motor City | Dubai Sports City | Arabian Ranches | Remraam
  • 21 mins – Dubai Marina |Dubai Media City | Mall of Emirates
  • 23 mins – Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 28 mins – Downtown Dubai | Burj Khalifa | Dubai Mall
  • 31 mins – Dubai International Airport
